name: ETC2019-165_rotor_cascade
source: Sebelev et al., ETC2019-165, Table 1 (rotor relative cascade proxy)
notes: Full paper is 3D nozzle+rotor URANS in CFX. This config is the 2D relative-frame
cascade equivalent used by ImpulseCalc (blade walls + density-based solver).
β1 paper magnitude 36°, α1 paper 20°, Dm=103.5 mm, Z2=55, B2≈9.5 mm, l2=10 mm.
Flow β1 is signed negative so ImpulseCalc Ct=Wt+U recovers |α1|≈20° with U>0.
Pure impulse: p_out≈0.95 p1 (expansion is in the nozzle, not the rotor).
Paper-like blade: t/c≈0.18, LE fillet ~ Seume 0.2 mm scale (not default 0.50 thick bucket).
